_comment: Laptop side of the reactor: where the Raspberry Pi is. mode "auto" = try pi_candidates in turn (the Pi's own Wi-Fi, the direct cable, bioreactor.local in a shared network) and show the route on the page. mode "pi" = one fixed pi_url. mode "simulator" = a Pi bridge with a virtual Arduino inside this server (no hardware; the page always shows СИМУЛЯТОР). Environment overrides: BIOREACTOR_SENSORS=auto|pi|simulator, BIOREACTOR_PI_URL=http://... (docs/raspberry_setup.md)
